name: @rectio/site
description: The rectio docs site and landing page: Fumadocs on Next.js, built as static files.

scripts.dev: node scripts/templates.ts && node scripts/previews.ts missing && node scripts/dev.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/templates.ts && next build && node scripts/previews.ts copy && node scripts/static-extras.ts
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/templates.ts && next typegen && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.showcase: showcase all --config showcase/light.config.mjs && showcase hero --config showcase/light.config.mjs && showcase all --config showcase/dark.config.mjs && showcase hero --config showcase/dark.config.mjs
